summary.text: Tisha Benoit, a No Labels Party healthcare practitioner and small business owner, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 4th Congressional District to Greg Stanton.
She describes herself as an Arizona native who grew up in the district.

paragraphs.text: According to her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Benoit grew up in District 4 and graduated from Marcos de Niza High School. She describes earning a bachelor's degree in Health Science, a master's degree in Traditional Chinese Medicine and a doctorate in Acupuncture and Chinese Medicine.

She says she has been a small business owner in Arizona with a healthcare practice focused on women's health, and that her community service includes volunteering on a medical mission in India and helping raise funds to build water wells in Cambodia.
She was the No Labels Party nominee for Arizona's 4th Congressional District.
Her campaign themes, per her Ballotpedia survey, were healthcare affordability and access, Arizona water security, and economic opportunity and government accountability.
She received 2.3% of the vote to Greg Stanton's 62.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
